No tests/reward.toml, extra tests entries, scratch, build output, caches, node_modules, databases/journals, archives, spreadsheets, or backups are shipped. They are legitimate task data, consistent with the workbook internal annotation and skill known-false-positive guidance, not residue. All 35 task-file hashes match the frozen manifest. Also verified all 25 frozen template hashes, workbook 6d44970b2ff67fefad1e2327e743fc226fcd4c50ff55baf899f41069a9b3fd7f, skill 8f2b660d1d32df90eb50990f401a0fc23a2ccbbcd49eeb5730bfbb9bef2bebc3, quality reference 2e1ec096f0ee9c125835acac033b682f87b002e8dc91c52a02965f964f31ff3a, contract 802aafcb4ff544d970e6d37e4f6d2c9abf0c3af61d70025e54b306f1befe6f73, and read policy/README hashes.
